plugin.unifi-os.name: UniFi OS
plugin.unifi-os.deploy.serverUrl.tooltip: Use the HTTPS management address. UniFi OS Server typically uses port 11443. UniFi consoles typically use port 443.
plugin.unifi-os.deploy.allowInsecureConn: Enable for a console with a self-signed certificate on a trusted network.
plugin.unifi-os.deploy.cleanupOldCertifi: After verification, remove inactive certificates created by this plugin for the same subject, SANs, and key type with an earlier start date.
